_comment: Committed performance baselines, KEYED BY MACHINE+TOOLCHAIN FINGERPRINT (tools/fingerprint.sh: CPU, ISA,
the engine's arch flag from cmake/DetectISA.cmake, compiler, AND the QuantLib reference's toolchain).
Policy (PRINCIPLES.md P9, ratified 2026-09-08): the gate is SELF-BASELINE (ours_ns within
policy.max_self_regression of the committed number for this fingerprint) plus ABSOLUTE TARGETS in
baselines/targets.json. QuantLib/XAD/rateslib numbers are an informational reference, never gating.
Timings are the MIN over repetitions on a quiesced machine (check_perf.py refuses to run under load).
History: 2026-07-10 .. 2026-09-08 the gate was a QuantLib-speedup floor (set 7-25x below measured) plus a
2x gross self-slowdown; the 1.25x self-regression band was advisory. Machines 52e94be82bc4 / a8c9a844826e /
86d5211c2c03 below were captured under that regime (mean-of-3, some under load) and are kept as history.
86d5211c2c03 paired a clang-21 engine with a clang-16 / AVX-512 QuantLib (fingerprint did not see the
QuantLib build) — its reference speedups are NOT like-for-like.
2026-09-08: metric keys renamed to say WHAT is built (market_size_operation); tools/check_perf.py --describe prints the full descriptions.

_retired_quantlib_floors.note: the pre-2026-09-08 min_speedup_vs_quantlib floors, retired (informational only now)

metric_descriptions.sofr_23k_square_cold_calibrate: USD SOFR single curve, 23 knots (6 FOMC meeting dates flat-forward + 17 spline knots), SQUARE: 23 instruments (1M averaging + 3M compounded SOFR futures, OIS to 30y) at the knot pillars, eval 2026-07-08. Cold global LM from a flat 3.5% start. Reference: QuantLib GlobalBootstrap (same algorithm class), never IterativeBootstrap.
metric_descriptions.sofr_23k_risk_ladder_23q_book9: Same SOFR 23-knot curve, already calibrated: full bucketed delta ladder over all 23 market quotes for a 9-swap OIS book. Ours = one AAD gradient + calibration Jacobian + one solve (rank-safe COD since 2026-09-07). Reference: QuantLib bump each quote / re-bootstrap (IterativeBootstrap, one-sided) / reprice.
metric_descriptions.sofr_23k_book1000_ois_reprice: 1000 OIS swaps off the SOFR 23-knot curve: par rate + NPV + PV01 as batched DF=exp(-Wx) algebra (W prebuilt). Reference: QuantLib per-swap NPV() loop, handle relinked each iteration so it must reprice.
metric_descriptions.sofr_23k_warm_recal_0p3bp: SOFR 23-knot curve: STREAMED re-calibration (StreamingCalibrator, exact frozen-Newton tick -- the path BundleSession::recalibrate runs) after a ±0.3 bp move on EVERY quote (alternating sign). Reference: QuantLib IterativeBootstrap re-bootstrap after the IDENTICAL move. Re-pointed 2026-09-10 (E6.1b): until then it timed the deleted cached-Jacobian WarmCalibrator.
metric_descriptions.sofr_23k_warm_recal_10bp: As above at ±10 bp -- a move large enough that the streamer may refresh its Jacobian. The honest big-move number. Re-pointed 2026-09-10 (E6.1b) from the deleted WarmCalibrator to the streamed tick.
metric_descriptions.ust_5000_clean_to_yield_sweep: 5000 seasoned semiannual US Treasuries, clean price → yield: ours = one batched Newton (Horner over the coupon polynomial) vs QuantLib BondFunctions::yield bond-for-bond (its default path is inflated by a solver artifact; the tuned baseline is also reported in the bench).
metric_descriptions.ust_5000_curve_book_dirty_price: The same 5000 UST book dirty-priced off a calibrated curve: ours = DF=exp(-Wx) + gathered flows + sparse per-bond reduction vs a per-bond QuantLib DiscountingBondEngine on the SAME discount factors.
metric_descriptions.sofr_swaption_cube17_sabr_reprice_warm: SOFR bundle (bench/fixtures/sofr_bundle.json, mid-2026, 1 curve, 9 instruments) already calibrated: reprice a 17-cell SABR swaption surface (a ±150 bp 1Y×5Y smile with 21 strikes + a 4×4 ATM expiry×tenor grid) with NO recalibration — one curve sample + a Bachelier/SABR pass. The live vol-surface number.
metric_descriptions.sofr_swaption_cube17_cold_calibrate_pric: Same 17-cell cube, but construct the session from JSON, calibrate the SOFR bundle, then price — the one-shot verb cost (Excel / fresh run_json).
metric_descriptions.chain8x26_session_cold_build_calibrate: DESK-SCALE SYNTHETIC SPREAD CHAIN: 8 curves (curve 0 outright + 7 spread curves each over the previous), 26 knots per curve (1 front + 25 back), annual par/basis pillars to 30y (annual coupons, ACT/ACT-style year fractions, no calendars) — 208 knots, 208 rows. BundleSession built from JSON + cold joint LM.
metric_descriptions.chain8x26_session_rebind: Same 8×26 chain: BundleSession::rebind (new quotes, same structure) — TODAY a full LM re-solve (13.6 ms), not a warm path; E6.2 target ≤ 1 ms.
metric_descriptions.chain8x26_session_rebind_reg: Same rebind with the tension-energy regulariser on (the SDK default): cached RegularizedEngine path.
metric_descriptions.chain8x26_session_stream_tick: Same 8×26 chain: one BundleSession::stream_update tick (frozen-Jacobian Newton to convergence on the compiled W-cache engine) after a small quote move.
metric_descriptions.chain8x26_book200_price_portfolio_onesho: 200-swap multi-curve book spread across all 8 forecast curves of the chain, ONE-SHOT price_portfolio (templated virtual-handle path, no bind) — NPV + AAD PV01.
metric_descriptions.chain8x26_book200_compiled_reprice: The same 200-swap book as ROWS of the one compiled engine (calibration::BookRows, what reprice_bound uses per tick; until 2026-10-06 the CompiledMultiCurveBook twin): one DF=exp(-W_all x) matvec + the gathered reduce, flipping between two curve states. Reference row: the templated virtual-handle path.
metric_descriptions.chain8x26_kernel_cold_joint_lm: Kernel-level (no session/JSON) cold joint LM on the 8×26 chain via the HybridBundleResidual.
metric_descriptions.chain8x26_kernel_one_residual: One residual evaluation of the 8×26 chain on the compiled W-cache engine (208 rows).
metric_descriptions.chain8x26_kernel_one_jacobian: One analytic support-blocked Jacobian of the 8×26 chain (208×208) — the per-LM-iteration cost.
metric_descriptions.usd_eur_xccy_3c8k_hybrid_jacobian: USD + EUR + EURUSD-xccy bundle, 3 curves × 8 knots: 12 par rows and 7 Portfolio-wrapped FX forwards on the compiled engine, plus 5 MtM xccy basis swaps (2-day funding-leg payment lag, fx spot 1.10) whose funding coupons carry the compounded PRODUCT observation so they are genuinely non-cacheable and ride the AAD block (since the row model compiles Portfolio FX and plain MtM legs, 2026-09-22; the fixture aborts if the block is empty). HybridBundleResidual::jacobian (AAD block dominates).
metric_descriptions.usd_eur_xccy_3c8k_aad_block_jacobian: The AadBlock forward-AAD sweep of the same bundle in isolation, pooled duals (touched width 24 ≤ kPooledMaxW=48). Reference row: the force-heap Dual fallback (the before/after of the DualPooled retype).
metric_descriptions.usd_eur_xccy_3c8k_stream_tick: One StreamingCalibrator tick on the same USD/EUR/xccy hybrid bundle.
metric_descriptions.shape_<name>_stream_tick: THE SHAPE LADDER (bench/fixtures/shape_ladder.hpp): one 0.1 bp streaming tick (frozen Jacobian) on the named instrument shape, real DB conventions and dates: ois_nolag (GBP SONIA), ois_lag (USD SOFR), ibor_multicurve (EUR ESTR + 6M EURIBOR spread), basis_spread (SOFR + FF ParSpread), averaged (+ monthly averaged FF futures), averaged_leg (FF OIS with daily-averaged float coupons), banded (+-1bp Huber bands), turns (year-end turn pin + bracketing future), portfolio (butterflies), zero_coupon (BRL DI x Pre), fx_xccy (SOFR + ESTR + EUR-in-USD FX forwards & MtM xccy; hybrid route), desk (all of it, 5 curves).
metric_descriptions.shape_<name>_refresh_25bp: Same shape, a 25 bp move each tick: Jacobian refresh + factorisation on every tick. On a banded shape the move is a FOUR-NUMBER requote -- every band moves with its target (K5', 2026-09-15: a target is never outside its band).
metric_descriptions.shape_<name>_jacobian: Same shape, one HybridBundleResidual::jacobian at x_true.
metric_descriptions.shape_<name>_requote_tick: Banded shapes only: a 0.1 bp FOUR-NUMBER requote tick -- every row's target AND band move together through BundleSession::stream_update(target, lower, upper, decay); the band move rides the streamer in place (a row re-scale), never a re-anchor. Replaced shape_<name>_edge_osc_tick (K5', 2026-09-15), which timed a banded target oscillating outside its band.
metric_descriptions.chain8x26_session_rebind_stamped: Desk-scale 8-curve spread chain (8x26 knots, 240 instruments, 6,975 float coupons): BundleSession::rebind with new quotes through the STAMPED overload -- the caller hands a cal::StampedBundle carrying the structural stamp hashed once when the structure was built, so the 'same structure' check is two integers instead of structure_equal's O(n) walk (measured 192 us of the unstamped 316 us). Same solve, same quote/band validation; only the structural check differs from chain8x26_session_rebind.
metric_descriptions.shape_mixed_scheme_residual_pwl: Shape ladder rung 'mixed_scheme' (29 rows, SOFR long end on MonotoneCubic) through the PIECEWISE-LINEAR W tier (HybridBundleResidual(p, pwl=true)): every compilable row -- including rows reading the curve's MonotoneCubic region -- rides the compiled W-cache, whose W is exact inside the Hyman filter's branch cell and re-taken by an analytic rank-k update when x crosses into another. The shipped router sends those rows to the AAD block instead; that arm is BM_Route_mixed_scheme_Residual_routed in the same binary. Opt-in: the tier is off unless a caller asks for it. Measures ONE residual evaluation.
metric_descriptions.shape_mixed_scheme_jacobian_pwl: Shape ladder rung 'mixed_scheme' (29 rows, SOFR long end on MonotoneCubic) through the PIECEWISE-LINEAR W tier (HybridBundleResidual(p, pwl=true)): every compilable row -- including rows reading the curve's MonotoneCubic region -- rides the compiled W-cache, whose W is exact inside the Hyman filter's branch cell and re-taken by an analytic rank-k update when x crosses into another. The shipped router sends those rows to the AAD block instead; that arm is BM_Route_mixed_scheme_Jacobian_routed in the same binary. Opt-in: the tier is off unless a caller asks for it. Measures ONE full Jacobian.
metric_descriptions.shape_desk_mixed_residual_pwl: Shape ladder rung 'desk_mixed' (70 rows, 5 curves, SOFR long end on MonotoneCubic) through the PIECEWISE-LINEAR W tier (HybridBundleResidual(p, pwl=true)): every compilable row -- including rows reading the curve's MonotoneCubic region -- rides the compiled W-cache, whose W is exact inside the Hyman filter's branch cell and re-taken by an analytic rank-k update when x crosses into another. The shipped router sends those rows to the AAD block instead; that arm is BM_Route_desk_mixed_Residual_routed in the same binary. Opt-in: the tier is off unless a caller asks for it. Measures ONE residual evaluation.
metric_descriptions.shape_desk_mixed_jacobian_pwl: Shape ladder rung 'desk_mixed' (70 rows, 5 curves, SOFR long end on MonotoneCubic) through the PIECEWISE-LINEAR W tier (HybridBundleResidual(p, pwl=true)): every compilable row -- including rows reading the curve's MonotoneCubic region -- rides the compiled W-cache, whose W is exact inside the Hyman filter's branch cell and re-taken by an analytic rank-k update when x crosses into another. The shipped router sends those rows to the AAD block instead; that arm is BM_Route_desk_mixed_Jacobian_routed in the same binary. Opt-in: the tier is off unless a caller asks for it. Measures ONE full Jacobian.
metric_descriptions.g10_8curve_cold_calibrate: G10 rates desk: 8 curves over 7 currencies (USD SOFR; EUR ESTR + EURIBOR 3M discounted on ESTR; GBP SONIA; JPY TONA; CHF SARON; CAD CORRA; AUD AONIA), 72 par instruments 1Y-30Y, conventions from the DB on both sides. Cold solve from a flat seed. Reference: QuantLib bootstrapping the same market curve by curve in dependency order (a DIFFERENT algorithm -- sequential exactly-determined bootstraps vs our one joint least-squares solve -- which is the point of the engine, not a handicap; both arms are held to the same answer by the bench's parity gate).
metric_descriptions.g10_8curve_tick_0p3bp: The same G10 desk re-curved on a market move: +-0.3 bp on EVERY one of the 72 quotes, alternating so neither arm can cache a no-op. Ours is a streamed frozen-Newton tick on the shared engine; QuantLib must re-bootstrap every curve whose helper quotes changed. This is the desk's real workload -- a cold solve happens once a day.
metric_descriptions.g10_book2000_reprice: 2,000 swaps spread across the G10 desk's eight curves (2Y/5Y/10Y/30Y, off-market fixed rates, mixed notionals), repriced off the calibrated curves. Ours is the bound book as rows of the compiled engine (DF = exp(-Wx) + batched coupon algebra, NPV plus the analytic parallel PV01 per reprice); the reference is QuantLib's per-swap NPV() walk. BOTH arms price off OUR calibrated curves (fresh term structures per iteration, so no cached NPV survives), so this times the repricing kernels, not two interpolations.
metric_descriptions.g10_<noturns|g4turns>_*: THE G10 DESK WITH AND WITHOUT YEAR-END TURNS (bench/g10_turns_bench.cpp, bench/fixtures/g10_market.hpp, QuantLib-free, 2026-10-13): the same 8-curve / 7-currency desk as g10_8curve_* (9 par swaps per curve from the DB conventions, maturities through the engine's own calendars) built twice -- plain (72 rows, 72 knots) and with one year-end turn [2026-12-31, 2027-01-04] on each G4 curve (USD SOFR, EUR ESTR, GBP SONIA, JPY TONA), each a bracketing December-to-January compounded observation + a TurnJump pin (80 rows, 76 knots). BOTH RUNGS ARE TIMED UNDER LIGHT SMOOTHING (region data, 0.5, one curvature row per interior knot), as a desk streams: the plain desk is SQUARE and on a square problem the streamer never refreshes (its 25 bp refresh read 26 us against 877 us turned), which would charge the turns for leaving the square regime rather than for the turns -- and no production bundle is square, smoothing rows being rows. cold_calibrate is cal::calibrate from the flat seed on the problem with its rows (the g10_8curve_cold_calibrate definition plus the rows); stream_tick a 0.1 bp per-row tick on the frozen Jacobian; refresh_25bp a 25 bp tilted move each way (premise: it refreshes); jacobian the hybrid engine's analytic Jacobian with the rows. The noturns rung is the CONTROL. Capture (min of 3, quiet machine): cold 3.43 -> 3.81 ms (1.11x), tick 13.6 -> 14.2 us (1.04x), Jacobian 111 -> 123 us (1.11x); refresh_25bp 29.7 us (0 refreshes) -> 1.45 ms (2 refreshes): since K48 (2026-10-13, smoothing rows are tie-breakers) the plain desk's quotes are SQUARE and it is exempt from the drift refresh (its premise is refreshes == 0), while the turned desk's two bracket rows per jump keep its quotes over-determined, so the refresh pair now gates the exemption itself rather than measuring a turn cost. The bench's premise check proves the RAW pair calibrates back to its generating state exactly with the four turns identified, and that the kernel rungs carry the same rows the session streams.

52e94be82bc4.notes: Captured by tools/check_perf.py --update (3 reps, benchmark_min_time=0.5s), machine load ~3. The speedup RATIOS are load-robust (both sides timed together); the absolute ns are not authoritative until re-captured on a quiesced machine.

a8c9a844826e.notes: AVX2 re-baseline (2026-07-29). The `isa` field below reflects the CPU capability (AVX-512), but the engine now BUILDS with AVX2 (256-bit / 4-wide Eigen packets) by default: SWAPS_ENABLE_AVX512 is OFF (cmake/DetectISA.cmake), because heavy AVX-512 DOWNCLOCKS this Intel core and measured SLOWER for the engine's small matrices -- curve_build 813->584us (-28%), risk_full_jacobian 826->497us (-40%), portfolio/warm ~flat. -march=native tuning minus the 512-bit width. Captured by check_perf.py --update (3 reps) with some background load (a concurrent compile); the speedup RATIOS are load-robust, absolute ns best-effort. Turn SWAPS_ENABLE_AVX512=ON to re-test on a core where AVX-512 does not throttle (e.g. AMD Zen4).
